scenarios.reasoning: The agent performed a methodical investigation with many tool calls and found relevant evidence (the NETSTANDARD define, the FSharp.Profiles.props file, evaluation properties). However, it constructed a plausible-sounding but fundamentally incorrect root cause analysis. The real issue is that FS0039 errors occur on net472 which lacks .NET Core APIs, but the agent blamed NETSTANDARD being defined on net10.0. The agent never verified which target framework the errors belonged to, which was a critical oversight. The investigation was thorough in mechanics but wrong in conclusion.

rubricScores.criterion: Recognized that the 'not defined' (FS0039) errors occur ONLY on the net472 target framework
Identified the undefined symbols as .NET-only runtime hot-reload/loading APIs: MetadataUpdater, AssemblyLoadContext, System.Runtime.Loader
Explained that net472 (.NET Framework 4.7.2) lacks these APIs, hence the FS0039 errors
Recognized FS0072 (type-inference) errors as a cascade downstream of the undefined symbols, not independent bugs
Noted that a small number of net10.0 errors (FS0001 type mismatches) are a separate, real problem
